title: Cannot log in after password reset email
content: Customer requested a password reset, received the email, but the new password is rejected at sign in. No error code. Resolved by clearing a stale session and walking them through MFA re-enrolment.

title: Locked out after too many MFA attempts
content: User exceeded MFA attempt limit and the account auto-locked. Unlocked from the admin console after identity verification. No code change required.

title: How do I add a teammate to my workspace
content: Plain how-to question about seat management. Answered with a KB link. No defect.

title: Charged twice for the same invoice this month
content: Duplicate line item on the monthly invoice. Investigation showed a manual plan change applied twice by an admin, not a payment fault. Refunded one charge within policy.

title: Need a VAT invoice for my EU entity
content: Customer needed a tax-compliant invoice reissued with a VAT number. Regenerated from the billing console.

title: Want to downgrade from Enterprise to Team plan
content: Plan change request with proration question. Handled entirely in the billing console.

title: Dashboard shows blank page after login
content: Customer sees an empty dashboard. Browser console shows a 500 from /api/v2/summary. Root cause was a bad feature flag rollout; rolled back by the platform team.

title: Reports take 40 seconds to load since Tuesday
content: Report generation latency regression. Traced to an unindexed filter added in a release. Platform team reverted the query change.

title: Getting 429 Too Many Requests on the public API
content: Customer hitting rate limits after increasing polling frequency. Explained limits, raised the plan quota, advised using webhooks instead of polling.

title: OAuth token refresh returns 401 invalid_grant
content: Refresh tokens rejected after client rotated credentials. API team identified the client was using the old client_secret. Config fix, no code change.

title: Our webhook endpoint stopped receiving events
content: Deliveries failing with connection refused. Customer firewall change blocked our egress range. Resolved by API support with an allow-list update.

title: Salesforce sync missing records since the weekend
content: Connector stopped syncing opportunities. Field mapping broke after the customer renamed a custom field in Salesforce. Integrations team remapped.

title: SAML SSO login loop with Okta
content: Users bounce between IdP and app. Certificate on the Okta side had been rotated without updating our metadata. Integrations team updated the SP config.

title: iOS app crashes on launch after 4.2.1 update
content: Crash loop on iOS 17 devices. Stack trace pointed to a nil unwrap in the onboarding controller. Mobile team shipped 4.2.2.

title: Push notifications not arriving on Android
content: FCM token registration failing silently for a subset of devices. Mobile team fixed token refresh handling.

title: Stripe webhook timeouts causing duplicate charges
content: Our handler exceeded the Stripe timeout, Stripe retried, and the missing idempotency key produced duplicate charges. Payments engineering added idempotency keys and made the handler async.

title: Subscription stuck in past_due after successful payment
content: Payment succeeded at the processor but our subscription state never advanced. Webhook event was dropped during a deploy. Payments engineering replayed events and added a reconciliation job.

title: Settlement report does not match processor totals
content: Daily settlement mismatch of several hundred transactions. Traced to a timezone bug in the settlement aggregation window. Fixed by payments engineering.

title: Deadlock detected on order table during checkout
content: Postgres deadlock under concurrent checkout load. Lock ordering inconsistency between two transactions. Database engineering reordered the writes.

title: Read replica lag over 5 minutes during peak
content: Replication lag causing stale reads in the UI. Long-running analytics query saturated the replica. Database engineering moved it to a dedicated replica.

title: Customer reports seeing another tenant's data
content: Serious isolation report. Security engineering confirmed a missing tenant filter on one internal endpoint, patched and audited access logs.

title: API key found published in a public GitHub repo
content: Credential exposure reported by a third party. Security engineering revoked the key, rotated, and reviewed usage for abuse.

title: Intermittent 503s from the EU region
content: Load balancer health checks flapping after an autoscaling change. Infrastructure team corrected the health-check threshold.

title: TLS certificate expired on the custom domain
content: Customer custom domain served an expired certificate. Renewal automation had failed silently. Infrastructure team renewed and fixed the alerting gap.
